provenance_api.types: AddressOrigin {pub register:Reg,pub offset:i64}; AddressAccess {pub instruction:u64,pub assignment:usize,pub origin:AddressOrigin,pub width:Width,pub kind:AccessKind}
provenance_api.rules: Only explicit input registers get symbolic origins; other/fresh regs unknown. All address query expressions with any Load must be rejected. Exact 8-byte spill store/load forwarding is allowed as an analysis fact, never remove actual loads/stores. Same-base disjoint modular byte ranges may survive; different entry bases may alias.

sequence_api.types: Evaluation::Assign {destination:Reg,value:Expr}, Load {destination:Reg,address:Expr,original_address:Expr,width:Width}, If {condition:Expr,taken:Vec<Evaluation>,not_taken:Vec<Evaluation>}; SequencedExpr {pub steps:Vec<Evaluation>,pub value:Expr,pub next_register:usize}; SequenceError
sequence_api.rules: All execution-facing step/value expressions contain no Loads except dedicated Load operation. original_address is metadata evaluated at original assignment point only, not replayed. Allocate every temporary >=first; return next_register. Select branches assign a shared result temp only on selected branch. Reject temp/input collision and bounded resource overflow.

outputSchema: scoped files, test commands/results, limits/open issues; no shared edits or commits
stop: finish individual worker within ~20 minutes then integrate; deadline 05:00 JST; no arbitrary scope expansion
value_width_api: ValueWidths::analyze(&Program)->Self; width(&self,Reg)->Width; width bounds unsigned observed values, not source signedness/types
